description: Defines the AccountTransferDTO class used for transferring account data within the Fineract system, including transaction details, account types, and related entities.

classes.name: AccountTransferDTO
classes.description: Data Transfer Object for account transfer details, including transaction info, account types, and related entities.

methods.name: getTransactionDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the transaction.

methods.name: getTransactionAmount
methods.description: Returns the amount involved in the transaction.

methods.name: getFromAccountType
methods.description: Returns the type of the source account.

methods.name: getToAccountType
methods.description: Returns the type of the destination account.

methods.name: getFromAccountId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the source account.

methods.name: getToAccountId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the destination account.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the transfer.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns the locale associated with the transfer.

methods.name: getFmt
methods.description: Returns the date formatter used.

methods.name: getPaymentDetail
methods.description: Returns the payment detail associated with the transfer.

methods.name: getFromTransferType
methods.description: Returns the transfer type from the source account.

methods.name: getToTransferType
methods.description: Returns the transfer type to the destination account.

methods.name: getChargeId
methods.description: Returns the charge ID related to the transfer.

methods.name: getLoanInstallmentNumber
methods.description: Returns the loan installment number involved.

methods.name: getTransferType
methods.description: Returns the overall transfer type.

methods.name: getAccountTransferDetails
methods.description: Returns additional account transfer details.

methods.name: getNoteText
methods.description: Returns the note text associated with the transfer.

methods.name: getTxnExternalId
methods.description: Returns the external transaction ID.

methods.name: getLoan
methods.description: Returns the loan associated with the transfer.

methods.name: getFromLoan
methods.description: Returns the source loan.

methods.name: getToLoan
methods.description: Returns the destination loan.

methods.name: getToSavingsAccount
methods.description: Returns the destination savings account.

methods.name: getFromSavingsAccount
methods.description: Returns the source savings account.

methods.name: isRegularTransaction
methods.description: Indicates if the transaction is regular.

methods.name: isExceptionForBalanceCheck
methods.description: Indicates if the transaction is an exception for balance check.
